Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If Jozz becomes a Laibon, and gets some Orun on him,
does that Orun allow him to enter combat with vampires
with capacity equal to twice his Orun-Enhanced capacity?

I would think "yes", because of the rulings regarding
vampires being "played".

Example:
Jozz has played Mozambique Allure and has 2 Orun on him.
His "orun-enhanced" capacity would be 6, for the purposes of
cards played by other Methuselahs.
Can he enter combat with vampires up to capacity 12?
(as long as they were originally played by someone else)

Card text:

Jozz [HttB:V]
Clan: Nagaraja
Group: 6
Capacity: 2
Disciplines: nec
Independent: Jozz may enter combat with a vampire no more than twice his
capacity or with an ally as a (D) action. Scarce

Orun
Master
Master: trifle.
Put this card on a Laibon. For non-Orun cards played by Methuselahs other
than this Laibon's controller, this Laibon is considered to have 2
additional capacity....

--
Jozxyqk
no relation

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Feb 11, 9:26 am, Jozxyqk <jfeue...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:
> If Jozz becomes a Laibon, and gets some Orun on him,
> does that Orun allow him to enter combat with vampires
> with capacity equal to twice his Orun-Enhanced capacity?
>
> I would think "yes", because of the rulings regarding
> vampires being "played".

No. Jozz sees them at their actual capacity.
Orun doesn't affect how Jozz sees other cards.
It affects how other cards see Jozz.
